title: QuickBooks Products And Services sorts A to Z, then flips on every click
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with the Settings - Parts permission.
  • {Location-A} is connected to QuickBooks, so the Categories list shows the QuickBooks Products And Services column.
  • QuickBooks product or service {Qb-item-A} (for example zzautotest item 9) exists in the connected QuickBooks company.
  • QuickBooks product or service {Qb-item-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Item 10) exists in the connected QuickBooks company.
  • QuickBooks product or service {Qb-item-C} (for example Zzautotest ITEM 100) exists in the connected QuickBooks company.
  • Category {Category-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC28 one) is mapped to {Qb-item-C}.
  • Category {Category-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC28 two) is mapped to {Qb-item-A}.
  • Category {Category-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PC28 three) is mapped to {Qb-item-B}.
  • You are on a page other than Categories, so the list opens sorted by Name.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings and click Categories in the Parts group of the Settings menu.
  2. Click the QuickBooks Products And Services column header.
  3. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  4. Read the QuickBooks header arrow and the order of {Category-A}, {Category-B} and {Category-C}.
  5. Click the QuickBooks Products And Services column header again.
  6. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  7. Read the QuickBooks header arrow and the order of {Category-A}, {Category-B} and {Category-C}.
  8. Click the QuickBooks Products And Services column header a third time.
  9. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  10. Read the QuickBooks header arrow and the order of {Category-A}, {Category-B} and {Category-C}.
  11. Click the QuickBooks Products And Services column header a fourth time.
  12. Move the mouse pointer away from the column headers.
  13. Read the QuickBooks header arrow and the order of {Category-A}, {Category-B} and {Category-C}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the QuickBooks header arrow points up and the three rows read, top to bottom, {Category-B} ({Qb-item-A}), {Category-C} ({Qb-item-B}), {Category-A} ({Qb-item-C}). With the examples: zzautotest item 9, ZZAUTOTEST Item 10, Zzautotest ITEM 100. Capitals make no difference and 9, 10, 100 are in counting order. Other categories may sit between them.
  • Step 7: the QuickBooks header arrow points down and the three rows read {Category-A}, {Category-C}, {Category-B} (Z to A).
  • Step 10: the third click sorts the list A to Z again, the same order as after the first click in step 2. The QuickBooks header arrow points up and the rows read {Category-B}, {Category-C}, {Category-A}. The list does not go back to an unsorted order or to the Name order.
  • Step 13: the fourth click flips it again. The QuickBooks header arrow points down and the rows read {Category-A}, {Category-C}, {Category-B} (Z to A).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11258; story SV-10134 (Story 1, Categories, sort by name; story text re-synced to the PRD on 13 Oct 2026); PRD "Settings Pricing And Categories Sorting (Price/Category)", Confluence 578781186, version 21 (14 Oct 2026), S1-R9, S1-R10, S1-R11, S1-R11a, S1-R12, §2 Sort arrows, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 1.2 (Categories - after) and 2.1 (The three rules that bite), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Price/Category QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R9: “The QuickBooks Products and Services column header is sortable.”
  • S1-R10: “When the user clicks the QuickBooks Products and Services header while that column is not sorted, the list sorts by that column in ascending order, A to Z.”
  • S1-R11: “When the user clicks that header again, the list re-sorts into descending order, Z to A.”
  • S1-R11a: “A third click re-sorts the list A to Z, the same as the first click. Every further click flips the direction again.”
  • S1-R12: “The QuickBooks Products and Services sort ignores whether letters are upper case or lower case, and compares numbers inside a value as numbers.”
  • PRD §2 Sort arrows: “Each click on the header being sorted flips its direction. A third click gives the same order as the first click. No click clears the sort or returns the list to its opening order.”
